fact: MakeMyTrip FY25 gross bookings (full fiscal year ended March 31, 2025)
value: $9.8 billion, up 25.9% YoY (constant currency) from $7.95 billion in FY24

fact: MakeMyTrip FY25 revenue (IFRS)
value: $978.3 million, up 27.4% YoY; Q4 FY25 revenue $245.5 million (+25.6% YoY)

fact: MakeMyTrip FY25 adjusted operating profit (EBIT) and full-year profit
value: Adjusted EBIT $167.3 million (up from $124.2M in FY24); full-year profit $95.3 million

fact: Myra AI assistant conversation volume and Tier-2/3 usage share
value: Over 3 million conversations per quarter (some reports cite 50,000/day at peak), with more than 45% of usage coming from Tier-2 and smaller cities

fact: Myra AI engagement depth and conversion lift
value: 35%+ of travelers engage with Myra up to 90 days before trip; 1 in 4 users return to ask itinerary/visa questions; Myra bookings convert ~10% more often than standard flow

fact: Myra 2.0 voice usage in Tier-2/3 cities vs metros
value: Voice usage is ~50% higher in Tier-2 and smaller towns than in metro areas; voice booking supported in 8 languages (Hindi, Tamil, Telugu, Marathi, Bengali, Kannada, Malayalam, English)

fact: MakeMyTrip-OpenAI collaboration for AI-led discovery
value: Announced Feb 2026; MakeMyTrip integrates OpenAI APIs into Myra to convert conversational/ChatGPT-style discovery into transaction-ready bookable options

fact: India online travel market size (IMARC estimate)
value: USD 55.74 billion in 2025, growing to USD 60.87 billion in 2026, projected to reach USD 126.01 billion by 2034 (CAGR 9.2%)

fact: India online travel market size (Mordor Intelligence estimate - alternate/conservative estimate)
value: USD 23.34 billion in 2025, growing to USD 38.58 billion by 2031 (CAGR 8.74%)

fact: MakeMyTrip lifetime transacted user base
value: Grew to 75 million lifetime transacted users across three brands (MakeMyTrip, Goibibo, redBus) as of Q1 FY25

fact: MakeMyTrip international (outbound) revenue share and growth
value: International business accounted for ~25% of overall revenue in FY25; international air ticketing revenue grew >33% YoY and international hotels revenue grew >65% YoY in FY25

fact: MakeMyTrip mobile bookings share and combined app downloads
value: Mobile bookings represent 66.7% of transactions; MakeMyTrip, Goibibo and redBus apps collectively have 100+ million downloads

fact: MakeMyTrip FY25 marketing and sales promotion expense
value: $165.3 million in FY25, up 34.1% from $123.3 million in FY24

fact: Competitor Ixigo's AI assistant TARA customer query resolution
value: TARA resolved 3.81 million customer queries in Q3 FY26 (up from 2.11 million in Q4 FY25); 76% of voice calls were fully resolved end-to-end by AI in Q3 FY26

fact: Indian OTA competitor market share clustering
value: Below MakeMyTrip (market leader), competitors Ixigo, Cleartrip, EaseMyTrip, and Yatra each hold roughly 7-9% market share

fact: MakeMyTrip Q2 FY25 revenue-less-service-cost and PAT growth
value: Rs 1,354 crore revenue (minus service costs) in Q2 FY25; profit after tax grew ~9X YoY to $18 million

fact: MakeMyTrip Trustpilot customer rating
value: Rated "Bad" at 1.2/5 based on 2,000+ reviews, with recurring complaints about fake/non-existent bookings, forced wallet refunds instead of cash refunds, and unhelpful AI-only customer support

fact: MakeMyTrip PissedConsumer rating and complaint themes
value: 1.4-star rating from 1,016 reviews, 17% likely to recommend; recurring complaints are refunds/refund delays, billing errors, and unreachable customer support especially for international users

fact: Train ticketing market context (adjacent to MakeMyTrip's bus/rail ambitions)
value: IRCTC holds ~80% direct market share in rail e-ticketing; third-party OTAs account for ~20% of ticket sales; train ticket market projected to reach $17.05 billion in 2025

fact: MakeMyTrip Q1 FY26 (fiscal 2027 Q1) results showing international travel headwinds
value: Revenue $285.6 million (+6.2% YoY reported, +16.1% CC); Gross Bookings $2,854.7 million (+19.9% CC); profit fell to $9.1M from $25.8M due to higher finance costs and subdued international outbound demand from West Asia conflict
